summary: Full-stack testing of Special Needs v3 2026 framework. Backend: 9/9 new API tests pass (schema shape d1..d10, intake, bulk answers+meta, complete, report/generate, share-link+public shared JSON, safety-triggered on Domain 10, invite self-accept blocked, comparison waiting->ready with two parents). Frontend: /special-needs-v3 renders results view with new 2026 overall banner ('Safety-Sensitive Review Recommended' when D10 triggered), zero references to old '10 Principles' or old ratings (Excellent/Good/Fair/Needs Improvement), all d1..d10 domain rows render, snv3-safety-alert + snv3-safety-link -> /safety-assessment present when triggered, intake step renders 3 groups / 21 fields, Skip advances to domains, Domain 1 shows 6 questions each with 5-button Likert row using the required labels (Strongly disagree/Disagree/Unsure or insufficient information/Agree/Strongly agree) and 4 meta chips (na/need_info/want_help/safety), Next disabled until every question answered, Domain 10 shows snv3-safety-notice. Invite: snv3-invite-create-btn creates link containing /invites/special-needs/<token>, snv3-invite-copy-btn appears. Public shared viewer /shared/special-needs/<token>: sharedsn-overall + sharedsn-strengths + sharedsn-growth + sharedsn-pdf-btn + sharedsn-sec-d1..d10 all render with '2026 framework · 10 domains' copy. Invite accept page (/invites/special-needs/<token>) renders sn-invite-card with sn-invite-accept-btn and surfaces 'Invite is invalid or expired.' error via sn-invite-error for bad tokens. Dashboard card copy = '10 Domains (2026)' (verified no '10 Principles' string).

minor.issue: invite_id is written only to in-progress docs (update_many filter completed:{$ne:true}). If a parent COMPLETES the assessment BEFORE creating an invite, the completed doc never gets invite_id attached, so GET /api/special-needs-v3/comparison returns 404. Users who complete first then decide to invite their co-parent silently get a broken comparison flow.

ui_bugs.issue: LegalAcknowledgment modal (storage key 'sac_legal_ack_v1') overlays and intercepts all clicks on the results view for first-time users. It doesn't block the /shared/* route but does block /special-needs-v3, meaning users landing on their fresh results after completing the assessment will be forced to acknowledge before they can click Share / PDF / Retake / Invite. Not a defect per se (product intent) but worth noting for the intake flow experience.

integration_issues.issue: If a user completes the assessment BEFORE clicking 'Generate co-parent invite link', the resulting invite is created but the comparison endpoint returns 404 (no doc with invite_id for this user). No waiting state is shown to the user — the check-status button toasts nothing visible. Consider: (a) in POST /invite also attach invite_id to the user's most recent COMPLETED doc when no in-progress doc exists, or (b) surface a friendly UI error so the user isn't confused.

action_items: Fix POST /api/special-needs-v3/invite to also attach invite_id to the user's latest completed sn_v3_assessments doc when there is no in-progress doc, so a completed inviter can start a comparison.
(Optional) When comparison returns 404 from the UI, surface a friendly toast/inline message so users don't silently sit at 'waiting'.
(Nit) sn_v3_routes.get_comparison's shared_priorities list-comp is one long line — consider extracting for readability.

(Nit) Old test file /app/backend/tests/test_sn_v3_api.py still asserts the OLD p1/p2 IDs and schema.sections[0].id == 'p1' and now has 3 failures against the new 2026 schema. Either delete it or update to d1..d10 (superseded by new test_sn_v3_2026_api.py).
critical_code_review_comments: sn_v3_routes.create_invite update_many uses {completed:{$ne:True}} which silently no-ops when the user has already completed → downstream comparison 404. Real product bug in the complete-first-then-invite path.

SpecialNeedsV3.jsx ResultsView: `growth` variable is destructured but the state is passed through report.growth_areas — fine. The 'toolkit' block only renders when report.communication_toolkit has items (server decides based on Domain 6 category) — correct behaviour.
SharedSpecialNeedsReport.jsx and SpecialNeedsV3.jsx duplicate the CATEGORY_TONE / OVERALL_TONE maps — extract to a shared module to guarantee tone parity if categories change.
SpecialNeedsInviteAccept.jsx: correctly redirects unauthenticated users to /login?redirect=... but does not preserve query params on the invite URL (fine — invite tokens are the whole path).

sn_v3_routes.accept_invite: does not verify the invite hasn't already been accepted by a DIFFERENT user. If two co-parents click the same link, the second acceptance silently overwrites the first (accepted_by). Consider blocking re-acceptance by a third party.
